# Journalism Web v1.0.13

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on functions that rely on specific web browser features.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-web/v1.0.13/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [downloadCSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-web/v1.0.13/docs/functions/downloadCSV.md): downloadCSV function
- [zipToUrls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-web/v1.0.13/docs/functions/zipToUrls.md): zipToUrls function
